question: Who has the best batting average in test cricket?
text: Australia’s **Sir Donald Bradman** holds the record for the highest career batting average in men’s Test cricket: **99.94** (minimum 20 innings). He scored 6,996 runs in 52 Tests from 1928 to 1948. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Test_cricket_records?utm_source=openai))
